data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: • Containers & Display: Form: Primary application surface and container for all UI controls. Label / PictureBox: Renders read-only system text, graphics, and asset icons. • Input & Execution: TextBox: Primary field capturing user string input at runtime. Button: Triggers click events to run underlying procedure logic. • Selection & Status: RadioButton / CheckBox: Captures single-choice or multi-state boolean options. ProgressBar: Visually reports task completion percentage to the user.
